scope: Exploratory frozen pretrained feature / linear probe study; all target cohorts previously observed; not a new blinded test.
pretraining_overlap: Official paper Appendix D does not list Sleep-EDF; no independent subject-identity audit of author private data.
encoder: LaBraM base, frozen original pretrained final token LayerNorm; mean non-CLS tokens per15seconds, concatenate two halves of30seconds into400features.
montage: Two bipolar channels Fpz-Cz and Pz-Oz. Positional embeddings are arithmetic means of endpoint electrode embeddings. This is an explicit exploratory heuristic, not an official bipolar-montage adapter.
preprocess: Existing100Hz centered/clipped waveform cache in100uV units; within-current30s window fourth-order0.1-45Hz zero-phase filter; polyphase resample to200Hz. Never filters across epoch boundary or future epochs. Original100Hz acquisition cannot supply45-75Hz information.
random_control: Same architecture and feature pooling, random initialization seed17; same endpoint embedding rule.
probe: StandardScaler fit source train only; multinomial logistic regression C in[.001,.01,.1,1,10],sqrt inverse source class frequency and equal source participant total weight. Mean source validation participant fixed5-class MacroF1 chooses C.
evaluation: Existing phase3 evaluation15 participants and older19 participants, reported separately. No seed-replication claim for convex probes or single random encoder.
numerical_solver_note: Initial max_iter500; if needed2000, then continue up to10000 more iterations at unchanged objective/tolerance. Only converged candidates accepted. This numerical fallback does not use target labels.
posthoc_capacity_control: Add random_plus_spectral452 after seeing complementarity, same source splits/C grid/weights/selection; avoids attributing dimension or random-feature nonlinear expansion to pretrained knowledge. All exploratory.
